description: This file defines the TransactionCommitter class which implements transaction commit logic in the Orleans framework, including methods for committing transactions, participating in lifecycle events, and managing transaction state.

classes.name: TransactionCommitter<TService>
classes.description: A generic class responsible for managing transaction commits, integrating with Orleans lifecycle, and coordinating transaction states and queue.

methods.name: OnCommit
methods.description: Handles commit operations within a transaction, managing locking, state copying, and execution of the commit operation.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the TransactionCommitter to Orleans grain lifecycle stages.

methods.name: OnSetupState
methods.description: Initializes transaction processing components and recovers state during setup.
